name: nothread
description: Single-hart replacements for musl's locking and thread primitives

objects.note: Single-hart replacements for musl's locking and thread primitives, which are where its lr/sc/amo* live. The bundled musl is built rv64ima, which is right for ZisK (rv64imafd) and wrong for SP1 and OpenVM (rv64im): SP1's loader panics on the first instruction it cannot decode, and OpenVM turns it into a trap. This works by definition, not by --wrap: a wrap would leave musl's members, and their atomics, in the image. So the object must precede libc.a: the linker takes an archive member only for a symbol that is still undefined. Only platforms with the no-atomics flag link it; ZisK keeps musl's real primitives, because its decoder accepts the A extension.
